svg.title: Runs And Dividers
svg.desc: A left-right comparison graphic showing 8 Ligconsolata Next samples. The left side is shaped from a smoke-built font with liga, dlig, and calt enabled, and the right side is the same raw ASCII source with ligatures disabled.
svg.text: Long runs become cleaner dividers without hiding short operators.
长 run 变成清爽分割线，同时不隐藏短操作符。

g.text: -- keeps a visible two-minus feel; ---- and longer divider samples can connect.
-- 保留两个减号的观感；---- 和更长分割线可以连起来。
Long underscore runs use sequence glyphs after the fixed six-cell range.
超过六格的下划线 run 使用 sequence glyph 延展。
